clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: First Aid directs adventurers with medical training to seek out Nurse Neela in Brill. By learning to construct a First Aid Kit for their campsites, travelers can provide life-saving treatment and recuperation while surviving deep in the wilderness.

Venturing beyond fortified settlements carries constant physical danger, from hostile beasts to opposing factions. For traveling practitioners of First Aid, learning to assemble a dedicated First Aid Kit allows an ordinary wilderness resting stop to serve as a mobile field clinic, patching up wounds and restoring vitality far from civil infrastructure.

In the Forsaken town of Brill, Nurse Neela provides instruction on turning basic medical expertise into practical camp equipment. Once a traveler demonstrates sufficient skill in bandaging and treatment, she shares the techniques required to construct a portable kit. Setting up such equipment requires a proper wilderness site centered around a basic campfire, which standard cooking instructors can teach travelers to build.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... And pragmatic pursuit as an adventurer.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
